metric_contract.counts: success + passed target miss + process failure = attempted; attempted + missing = planned
metric_contract.pairing: timing and ratios use joint target-success pairs only; all planned pairs remain in denominator
metric_contract.phase: hash-bound passed rows' cumulative counters; diagnostic includes preparation/preflight; bound includes MBE/LB work
metric_contract.planner: all attempted rows with finite planner time
metric_contract.ttt: success-only JVM launch to first qualifying certificate

protocol_purpose: Diagnostic baseline for faster AnytimeTarget3%/5% versus Global; four selected workloads, two networks; single repetition, not final benchmark.
